name: Old Rag Mountain circuit
why: The hardest classic walk of the East: a ridge of granite boulders to squeeze through and climb over, then a summit with the Blue Ridge all around.
book: Day-use ticket from 1 March to 30 November on recreation.gov ($2, 800 a day: half released 30 days ahead, half 5 days ahead), plus the park entrance pass. The main trailhead lot is closed for works since May 2026: use the overflow lots.
dangers: The rock scramble is slow: queues on busy days, rescues every year.
Rock is slick when wet: skip the scramble after rain.
Summer heat and humidity: start early.
turnaround: Be at the start of the rock scramble by 12:00, or come down the way you went up.
